Furazolidone is given orally in a dose of 100 mg four times daily; children and infants from 1 month of age may be given 1.25 mg/kg four times daily. It is usually given for 2 to 5 days, but may be given for up to 7 days in some patients, or for up to 10 days for giardiasis. Peptic ulcer disease.
